primitive_first_reciprocal_shell: all six cancel in infinite rigid periodic average
first_shell_barrier_per_top_Bravais_cell: Delta E_1(z)=9*abs(V_star(z)); assumes only this shell and real isotropic pair Fourier coefficient
equilibrium_load_identity: d Delta H / d L = z_top - z_bottom on smooth relaxed branches, compressive L per cell
weak_corrugation_slope: d Delta H / d L = -9 d_z abs(V_star)/k_z + higher corrugation
exponential_specialization: d_L ln Delta H ~= kappa/k_z when V_star=V_0 exp(-kappa z)
friction_caveat: barrier slope is not measured friction slope without a dynamics/readout law
verification: exact rational shell/coset/basis enumeration and solvable equilibrium load identity; analytical first-shell range
source: Chen et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 166201 (2026), DOI 10.1103/ly48-b4l2, public abstract only
